title: Makuti For Sale
description:
structure with a thatched roof, commonly known as a makuti roof, which is popular in Kenya and other tropical regions.
Makuti is a natural and eco-friendly roofing material made from woven palm fronds.
It is known for not retaining heat, which helps keep the interior of a building cool in humid tropical climates.
